$comment: A starting point, not a description of what this repository already has.
install offers this set only where the tracker carries nothing but its own
defaults. A repository with labels of its own keeps them, and AEP maps onto
what is there rather than adding a second vocabulary beside it.
Every description states the trigger that puts the label on, because a
description that restates the name tells a reader nothing they did not have,
and size: in particular is unusable without its thresholds written down.
No label here names AEP. A tracker is read by people who never installed it.

status.why: where the effort stands, projected from spec.md's status: field. Derived: re-synced on every write, and the file wins when they disagree.

labels.name: status: backlog
labels.description: Specified but not yet accepted. Set while the spec is still a draft.

labels.name: status: ready
labels.description: Accepted and cut into tickets. Nothing is blocking a start.

labels.name: status: in progress
labels.description: Work has started. Set when the first ticket is taken.

labels.name: status: in review
labels.description: Converge found no gap and the pull request is ready for a human.

labels.name: status: done
labels.description: Merged, or closed without merging. Set on both objects when the pull request closes.

type.why: what kind of change this is, read from what the spec describes. Derived.

labels.name: type: feature
labels.description: Adds behaviour that did not exist. Use when the spec states a new capability.

labels.name: type: bug
labels.description: Restores behaviour that was specified and is not happening.

labels.name: type: refactor
labels.description: Changes structure with no change in behaviour. Use when no acceptance criterion is about output.

labels.name: type: docs
labels.description: Changes what is written rather than what runs.

labels.name: type: chore
labels.description: Maintenance with no product effect: tooling, configuration, housekeeping.

size.why: how much diff a reviewer is being asked to read, computed from the diff when the pull request goes ready. Derived. The thresholds live in the descriptions, so the label can be recomputed by anyone without a second document.

labels.name: size: xs
labels.description: Under 10 changed lines.

labels.name: size: s
labels.description: 10 to 99 changed lines.

labels.name: size: m
labels.description: 100 to 499 changed lines.

labels.name: size: l
labels.description: 500 to 999 changed lines.

labels.name: size: xl
labels.description: 1000 changed lines or more. Consider whether this is one effort.

priority.why: how soon this matters. Initial: set once when the effort is opened, from the human's answer, and never revised by an agent. A human's change to one is never overwritten.

labels.name: priority: critical
labels.description: Work stops elsewhere until this lands.

labels.name: priority: high
labels.description: Wanted in the current cycle.

labels.name: priority: medium
labels.description: Wanted, with no date attached.

labels.name: priority: low
labels.description: Worth doing when nothing above it is waiting.

flag.why: a fact that changes how someone reads the effort. Each is set only where a fact establishes it, and a flag with no fact behind it is not set. The two that invite another person to act, discussion and wontfix, are initial rather than derived.

labels.name: flag: breaking changes
labels.description: Changes a public contract or data at rest. Set when the trip-wire fires.

labels.name: flag: dependencies
labels.description: Changes a dependency manifest or a lockfile.

labels.name: flag: release
labels.description: Changes what a release publishes: version, changelog, or packaging.

labels.name: flag: discussion
labels.description: The spec still carries open questions. Set to invite an answer.

labels.name: flag: triage
labels.description: A fresh draft nobody has judged yet.

labels.name: flag: confirmed
labels.description: Reproduced, or otherwise established as real.

labels.name: flag: unconfirmed
labels.description: Reported and not yet reproduced.

labels.name: flag: cant reproduce
labels.description: Attempted and not reproduced. Says what was tried.

labels.name: flag: wontfix
labels.description: Abandoned deliberately. Set on both objects when an effort is dropped.
